import.title: Import activities
import.instructionsSingle: Export the original file of the activity from Garmin Connect or from the COROS app, then upload it here. FIT, GPX and TCX formats are accepted.
import.instructionsAll: Request a full export of your Garmin account data and upload the ZIP file here as is, without extracting it.
